floor: One broad, continuous theme-specific floor material with no small repeated texture.
main_structure: One iconic rear landmark made from a few large forms.

perimeter.material: continuous smooth hedge, parapet, or themed border
perimeter.emblems: up to four oversized simple emblems

lighting: soft warm lighting with at most two or three large practical lights
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as a quiet open themed floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
